title: Stopwatch with laps and split times
when: The user wants a stopwatch with start, stop, reset and lap times, showing hundredths and the fastest and slowest laps.
prompt:
Goal: A jitter free stopwatch whose elapsed time and laps are exact and survive a reload.
Steps:
1. Elapsed = accumulated + (running ? Date.now() - startedAt : 0); stopping adds to accumulated.
2. logic.mjs: format(ms) as mm:ss.cc and h:mm:ss.cc past an hour, laps(marks) giving lap and total, fastest and slowest indexes.
3. Buttons: Start and Stop toggle with a changing label, Lap while running, Reset while stopped; Space and L as shortcuts outside fields.
4. Display with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, redrawn by requestAnimationFrame only while running.
5. Laps table newest first with th headers (number, lap, total); fastest and slowest marked with words; new lap announced in aria-live.
6. Persist startedAt, accumulated and marks in localStorage guarded; Copy or Download CSV of laps.
7. test.mjs: format rounding, lap math, fastest and slowest with ties.
Quality bar:
- Digits do not shift width.
- A reload mid run keeps counting.
- Buttons are at least 48 px.
Pitfalls:
- Adding 10 ms per interval tick.
- Keyboard shortcuts firing while typing.
- requestAnimationFrame running while stopped.
Verify:
- [ ] Elapsed from timestamps.
- [ ] Table uses th.
- [ ] Reset clears laps.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (time math), test.mjs.

examples.output: 00:42.17 display, Start/Lap/Reset, laps table with fastest and slowest
